description: This file defines the SsmClient class for AWS SDK, providing methods to interact with the Amazon EC2 Simple Systems Manager service, including method signatures for various operations and asynchronous variants.

classes.name: SsmClient
classes.description: AWS SDK client for Amazon EC2 Simple Systems Manager, extending AwsClient with specific method signatures for SSM operations.
